execution_freeze.authentic_input: Real staging package files and the existing real target directory.
execution_freeze.provenance_selection: Source fixed by M8-19 audit; target fixed by the user-requested ~/.codex/pets/sha-wujing path.
execution_freeze.right_to_use_and_privacy: User explicitly authorized local project testing and continued after the installation question; scope limited to two package files and target directory.
execution_freeze.primary_metric: Exact SHA-256 and byte equality for pet.json and spritesheet.webp.
execution_freeze.measurement: Read source and target bytes, compare SHA-256 and size, then attempt a bounded runtime visibility check.
execution_freeze.evaluator: Deterministic hash comparison; runtime visibility attempted through Computer Use but blocked by app safety policy.
execution_freeze.pass_threshold: Both target files exist and match source SHA-256 and size; no unexpected target file is introduced.
guardrails: No overwrite when target is already identical
No secrets, cookies, tokens or unrelated paths
No deletion or rollback write unless a separate approved mutation is needed
abort_conditions: Any hash mismatch requiring overwrite without a fresh approval
Runtime check asks for credentials, external messages or broader file access
Computer Use cannot safely observe Codex without bypassing safety policy
execution_steps: Read source and target manifest, hashes and sizes.
Treat identical target as an idempotent no-op; do not copy.
Attempt bounded runtime visibility only through allowed Computer Use.
execution_freeze.required_authorization: User continuation after the explicit installation question; no new write was needed because target was already identical.

decision_mapping.PASS: Keep the existing target and proceed only to a separately approved runtime or user-acceptance check.
decision_mapping.PARTIAL: Preserve the exact target; report the missing runtime evidence and do not claim full install smoke.
decision_mapping.NO-GO: Do not overwrite or install; investigate target mismatch or boundary violation.
